name: Observability (Langfuse)
description: Traces OpenClaw conversations, LLM calls, and tool usage to Langfuse. Requires the 'langfuse' npm package and credentials. Fail-open: if the SDK is missing or credentials are not configured, all hooks are inert. Inspired by hermes-agent/plugins/observability/langfuse.

publicKey.description: Langfuse project public key (pk-lf-...). Also reads OPENCLAW_LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY env var.

secretKey.description: Langfuse project secret key (sk-lf-...). Also reads OPENCLAW_LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY env var.

baseUrl.description: Langfuse server URL (default: https://cloud.langfuse.com). Also reads OPENCLAW_LANGFUSE_BASE_URL env var.

maxChars.description: Maximum characters per traced field to prevent oversized payloads (default: 12000)
